One scope improving is a mixed tradeoff, neither is unsupported. Report supported_initial/shared_v1 ratios explicitly; improvement versus tanh is not restoration to original accuracy. measurements.growth_interpretation: 1000m/s or1000rad/s is a catastrophic-growth diagnostic only, not stability or application adequacy. All-time full-state finiteness plus both maxima<1000 describes absence of observed catastrophic growth in this known set only.
measurements.paired: For every contrast and scope/kind/horizon/statistic/group, retain all planned and truth-eligible counts and both failure counts; report common-finite count/fraction and balanced common-finite physical RMSE/ratio. Undefined empty subsets remain null. Never interpret conditional ratios as full-population accuracy.
measurements.response: Signed branch prediction minus same-model factual prediction, compared with signed branch truth minus factual truth; intersect truth validity. Require exact parent/origin/scope/history/factual association.
measurements.scoring: Float64 physical component MSE in each horizon/group/statistic; equal branches within origin, origins within parent, then parents within each scope/kind cell. No pooling the scopes. Full eligible-cohort RMSE undefined if any eligible prediction fails; preserve planned/eligible/failure/parent counts.

Preserve failures and extreme finite outputs independently of response subtraction.

representation.numeric_implementation: Return z directly through where for abs(z)<=S, preserving dtype and signed zero. Compute the other branch from nonnegative excess=max(abs(z)-S,0), never squaring unbounded coordinates. Float64 support derivation; float32 application casts bounds exactly as historical model inference.
representation.properties: Odd, monotonically increasing, C2 but not C3 at joins, derivative1 and second derivative0 inside and at joins. First derivative between0and1; asymptotic coordinate bound4S (finite precision may equal it). Synthetic float32/64 value/Jacobian/second-derivative tests includingzero,joins,tail,maximumfinite. No physical derivative or stability qualification.
representation.rule: Coordinatewise: phi(z)=z if abs(z)<=S; otherwise sign(z)*(S+3*S*tanh((abs(z)-S)/(3*S))). S=motion_bound_scale/4. One fixed function and tail width; no alternatives or tuning.
